bagPolicy.summary: Patrons may only bring one clear bag no larger than 12"x12"x6".
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: More than 10,000 parking spaces are available within a 10-minute walk of Rupp Arena. Parking fees apply for most events, with payments accepted via major credit cards and mobile payments. Prepaid parking is available for some events through ParkWhiz.
lots: Rupp Arena parking lot on West High Street

rideshare.note: Use the curb cut on Main Street for taxi, Uber, Lyft, and other rideshare pickup and drop-off.

concessions.note: Hardwood & Oak offers a unique food and hospitality experience at Rupp Arena, featuring classic southern staples like stone-ground grits and bourbon braised short ribs. They provide a range of services from cocktail receptions to full dinner menus, emphasizing fresh ingredients and southern hospitality.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Buy accessible seating through the Central Bank Center Ticket Office or Ticketmaster; for UK events, call UK's ticket office. Service animals are welcome on a leash or harness, so mention one when you buy to reserve an aisle seat. A wellness room for sensory needs or nursing is outside Section 30 during all arena events.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Rupp Arena has a no re-entry policy during events. Return anything to your car before your ticket is scanned.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Central Bank Center Ticket Office window is just inside the High Street entrance, between the Hyatt Regency Hotel and Rupp Arena, and is open Wednesdays and Fridays from 12pm to 4pm. Phone lines are open Tuesday to Friday, 10am to 4pm. Only Ticketmaster and this ticket office are authorized sellers.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Rupp Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
